text: こわっぱ　ごときが　せっしゃに　たたかいを　いどむとは　かたはら　いたいわ！

structure.jp: こわっぱ　ごときが
せっしゃに　たたかいを　いどむとは
structure.en: to think you'd challenge me to battle

structure.jp: かたはら　いたいわ！

patterns.name: 〜ごとき
patterns.explanation: ごとき after a person looks down on them: 'the likes of'. It is an old, stiff word that suits Koga's ninja speech. こわっぱ　ごとき = 'the likes of a brat'.

patterns.name: 〜とは
patterns.explanation: とは after a verb shows surprise or scorn at what was just said: 'to think that'. たたかいを　いどむとは = 'to think you'd challenge me to battle'.
